title: Full-Scale Release Evidence Bundle
description: Schema for the immutable release evidence package required by 25_DEEP_ARCHITECTURAL_AUDIT_AND_FULL_SCALE_RELEASE_PROFILE.md §8. A release candidate is eligible for production review ONLY when the bundle contains all ten items. 'Missing, stale, unverifiable, or contradictory evidence is a release failure. A waiver must be time-bounded, narrowly scoped, approved by the accountable risk owner and security owner, and cannot waive legal eligibility, adult account-holder requirements, audit integrity, risk authorization, or the ability to halt safely.'

evidence_1_build_identity.description: §8 item 1: 'Source commit, protected-branch review, build identity, toolchain versions, dependency lockfiles, SBOM, provenance, and artifact digest.' Corroborated by 09_TESTING_AND_RELEASE_EVIDENCE.md §Evidence package and 02_POLYGLOT_ENGINEERING_STANDARD.md §10 supply-chain baseline.

evidence_2_test_results.description: §8 item 2: 'Passing unit, integration, contract, property/invariant, migration, security, privacy, accessibility, load, resilience, and recovery tests applicable to the change.' Corroborated by 09_TESTING_AND_RELEASE_EVIDENCE.md §CI gates and 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §11 item 1.

evidence_3_configuration_and_policy.description: §8 item 3: 'Configuration and policy bundle digests, reviewed diffs, feature-flag state, schema version, and rollback/forward-fix procedure.' Corroborated by 17_CONFIGURATION_AND_RISK_POLICY.md §1 and §6 and 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §5.

evidence_4_threat_model_and_security.description: §8 item 4: 'Threat model and security review status; no unresolved release-blocking finding or expired exception.' Corroborated by 06_SECURITY_AND_ACCESS_CONTROL.md §8 and 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §7.

evidence_5_authorization_and_eligibility.description: §8 item 5: 'Authorization and dual-control evidence for privileged changes; exact-scope eligibility evidence where applicable.' Corroborated by 11_EXECUTION_GATES.md G11, 21_ZERO_TRUST_SSO_AND_AUTHORIZATION.md §6, and 18_GOVERNANCE_DATA_AND_COMPLIANCE.md §5.

evidence_6_observability_readiness.description: §8 item 6: 'Observability readiness: dashboards, alert routes, on-call owner, SLO impact, and incident runbook.' Corroborated by 08_NFR_OBSERVABILITY_AND_CAPACITY.md §Observability ('alerts without a response action are not production alerts') and 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §2 ('Every production alert has an owner and executable response procedure').

evidence_7_database_and_event_compatibil.description: §8 item 7: 'Database and event compatibility proof, including replay/idempotency behavior where applicable.' Corroborated by 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §5 (expand/contract migration discipline) and 05_PERSISTENCE_EVENTING_RECONCILIATION.md §Outbox.

evidence_8_recovery_and_backup.description: §8 item 8: 'Recovery and backup evidence within the required exercise window; recovery hold and resume authorization evidence.' Corroborated by 10_OPERATIONS_AND_DISASTER_RECOVERY.md §Drill schedule (monthly backup restore verification, quarterly regional recovery exercise) and §Recovery topology (RECOVERY_HOLD).

evidence_9_gate_report.description: §8 item 9: 'Gate report with binary PASS/FAIL, evidence references, reviewer identities, UTC timestamps, commit and artifact digests.' Corroborated by 11_EXECUTION_GATES.md ('partial completion is FAIL, not a percentage') and 20_FINAL_AUDIT_CLOSURE_AND_ACCEPTANCE.md §5 required gate evidence record.

evidence_10_post_deployment_verification.description: §8 item 10: 'Post-deployment verification plan, canary boundaries, abort criteria, rollback decision owner, and explicit completion record.' Corroborated by 11_EXECUTION_GATES.md G11 (canary, abort criteria, responsible operator) and 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §15.

sha256_digest.description: A content digest. 25 §8 item 1 records the artifact digest; item 9 records commit and artifact digests.

uri.description: Immutable URI or repository path. 11_EXECUTION_GATES.md: 'Each gate report must identify its evidence artifacts by immutable URI or repository path and content digest.'

immutable.description: Whether the artifact is stored under an immutable/WORM policy. 22_AUDIT_INTEGRITY_AND_EVIDENCE.md §4 requires object-lock/WORM retention for audit evidence.

identity.description: Reviewer identity from the identity broker. 21_ZERO_TRUST_SSO_AND_AUTHORIZATION.md §4: 'service identities cannot impersonate humans'.

step_up_satisfied.description: Whether phishing-resistant step-up was completed. 06_SECURITY_AND_ACCESS_CONTROL.md §2 requires step-up for live activation, risk-policy changes, credential rotation, permission grants, account/venue enablement, emergency override, and confidential export, with re-authentication freshness at most 5 minutes.

distinct_from_requester.description: Whether this identity is distinct from the requester. 06_SECURITY_AND_ACCESS_CONTROL.md §3: 'The initiating actor and approver must be distinct identities.'

protected_branch_review.description: Review record proving mandatory code review on a protected branch. 06_SECURITY_AND_ACCESS_CONTROL.md §7 lists 'protected branches; mandatory code review' as mandatory controls.

toolchain_versions.description: Exact pinned toolchain versions. 23_ARCHITECTURE_AND_COMPLIANCE_DECISIONS.md §7: versions are 'pinned exactly, and recorded in release evidence. End-of-life runtimes are prohibited.' 00_README.md §Toolchain lifecycle: 'CI must fail on unpinned dependencies or toolchain drift.'

dependency_lockfiles.description: Lockfiles for every language in the polyglot build. 02_POLYGLOT_ENGINEERING_STANDARD.md: 'Dependencies are pinned by lockfiles.'

artifact_digests.description: Every promoted artifact digest. 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §15: 'Production releases use immutable artifacts'; no rebuild between environments.

images_digest_pinned.description: Must be true: no mutable tag and no :latest reference anywhere. 23 §2 requires immutable OCI images.

all_applicable_suites_passed.description: 25 §8 item 2 requires passing results for all tests applicable to the change.

mandatory_financial_invariants_verified.description: 09_TESTING_AND_RELEASE_EVIDENCE.md §Mandatory financial invariants enumerates 8 invariants that MUST each have automated coverage.

configuration_digest.description: 17_CONFIGURATION_AND_RISK_POLICY.md §1: configuration is 'immutable after activation'; a change creates a new revision.

policy_bundle_digest.description: 21_ZERO_TRUST_SSO_AND_AUTHORIZATION.md §10: policies are 'version-controlled, peer-reviewed, signed, and deployed as immutable bundles'.

feature_flag_state.description: Every flag with environment, scope, expiry, owner, approval, and kill switch. 24 §3: 'Feature flags are configuration, not authorization... Every flag has an owner, scope, creation time, expiry, reason, and audit record.'

kill_switch.description: 24 §2 requires a kill switch for every feature flag.

dual_approved.description: 24 §3: 'Production flags affecting risk, identity, reconciliation, ledger, or execution behavior require dual approval.'

rollback_procedure.description: 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §15: rollback uses a previously verified immutable artifact and compatible schema state.

drift_check_performed.description: 24 §5: 'Drift detection compares desired and observed state continuously'.

threat_model.description: 24 §7: 'Threat models are maintained for identity, control-plane APIs, AI/research ingestion, adapters, persistence, audit evidence, and recovery infrastructure.'

unresolved_release_blocking_findings.description: Must be empty. 25 §8 item 4: 'no unresolved release-blocking finding'.

remediation_deadline_utc.description: 06_SECURITY_AND_ACCESS_CONTROL.md §7: 'Critical vulnerability remediation target is 24 hours for exploitable internet-facing components and 7 days for other production components'.

expires_at_utc.description: 24 §7: 'Security exceptions are time-bounded and automatically expire.'

penetration_test.description: 06 §8: 'external penetration test before live activation and annually thereafter'.

scans.description: SAST, dependency scan, license scan, container scan, IaC scan, DAST, secret scan. 06 §7 mandatory controls.

authorization_test_vectors.description: 21_ZERO_TRUST_SSO_AND_AUTHORIZATION.md §9 enumerates the required negative and positive authorization test cases.

distinct.description: 06_SECURITY_AND_ACCESS_CONTROL.md §3 requires distinct identities for financial control actions.

exact_diff_reviewed.description: 21 §6: 'Any change to the diff invalidates approval.'

approval_expires_at_utc.description: 21 §6: approval expires after 24 hours and must be renewed.

eligibility_scope_applicable.description: Whether this release touches a jurisdiction-eligible scope.

eligibility_evidence.description: Exact-scope eligibility evidence. 18_GOVERNANCE_DATA_AND_COMPLIANCE.md §5: 'No live credentials are provisioned before eligibility approval.'

account_holder_adult_and_eligible.description: 23_ARCHITECTURE_AND_COMPLIANCE_DECISIONS.md §5 requires a legally eligible adult account holder with verified identity and account authority. Non-waivable.

dashboards.description: 08 §Observability: dashboards show SLO burn rate, error budget remaining, market/venue/environment segmentation, and deployment annotations.

oncall_owner.description: 25 §7: 'An unowned service is not eligible for production promotion.'

slo_impact.description: 25 §7: SLOs must be measured from user-visible and authoritative outcomes.

incident_runbooks.description: 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §2: 'Every production alert has an owner and executable response procedure.'

sensitive_data_scan.description: 25 §5 Observability release evidence includes a 'sensitive-data scan'.

database_compatibility.description: 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §5: expand/contract migration; a migration must remain compatible with the immediately previous release until rollback is no longer required.

event_compatibility.description: 02_POLYGLOT_ENGINEERING_STANDARD.md: schema changes require backward compatibility for one release window unless a coordinated migration is executed.

idempotency_replay_evidence.description: 05_PERSISTENCE_EVENTING_RECONCILIATION.md §Outbox: 'Duplicate publication is acceptable; consumers must be idempotent.' 03_CANONICAL_CONTRACTS.md §Idempotency: 'Database uniqueness constraints enforce idempotency; application memory is never sufficient.'

backup_restore_evidence.description: 10_OPERATIONS_AND_DISASTER_RECOVERY.md §Drill schedule: 'Monthly backup restore verification.' 05_PERSISTENCE_EVENTING_RECONCILIATION.md §Backup additionally requires weekly restore verification.

recovery_hold_authorization.description: 10: 'Re-enable requires: database/ledger invariants pass; order/fill/balance/position reconciliation completed or explicitly dispositioned; market-data freshness verified; risk configuration and signing keys verified; smoke/fault checks pass; and two distinct authorized approvers sign the scope-specific release.'

rto_minutes_observed.description: Measured elapsed time from declared incident start to restored service. 08: objectives are 'measured from declared incident start to restored service and validated by drills'.

objectives_demonstrated.description: 12_DECISION_REGISTER.md ADR-025: 'The platform must not claim these objectives until restore/failover drills demonstrate them.'

gate_id.description: 11_EXECUTION_GATES.md defines G0 through G11. G0 is package/spec integrity; G11 is a separate, dual-approved live-activation decision.

result.description: Binary only. 11: 'A gate is PASS only when every listed criterion is satisfied; partial completion is FAIL, not a percentage.'

exceptions.description: 20 §5 requires an `exceptions` field. 11: any noncritical exception requires a time-bounded risk acceptance by the owner and security/risk reviewers, a compensating control, expiry date, and linked remediation issue; it 'does not convert a failed mandatory criterion into PASS'.

waiver.description: 25 §8: a waiver must be time-bounded, narrowly scoped, approved by the accountable risk owner AND security owner. It 'cannot waive legal eligibility, adult account-holder requirements, audit integrity, risk authorization, or the ability to halt safely.' 11_EXECUTION_GATES.md additionally prohibits waivers for financial invariants, authorization, live credential isolation, reconciliation, halt controls, and recovery objectives.

canary_boundaries.description: 11_EXECUTION_GATES.md G11: 'a canary activation runs in the narrowest permitted scope'.

completion_record.description: 25 §8 item 10 requires an explicit completion record.

audit_chain_verified_before_and_after.description: 24_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE_STANDARD.md §11 item 7: 'Audit-chain verification passes before and after deployment.' 22_AUDIT_INTEGRITY_AND_EVIDENCE.md §3: verification runs after restore/deployment.

x-blueprint-constraints.citation: 25_DEEP_ARCHITECTURAL_AUDIT_AND_FULL_SCALE_RELEASE_PROFILE.md §8: a waiver 'cannot waive legal eligibility, adult account-holder requirements, audit integrity, risk authorization, or the ability to halt safely.' 11_EXECUTION_GATES.md: 'Waivers are prohibited for financial invariants, authorization, live credential isolation, reconciliation, halt controls, and recovery objectives.'
x-blueprint-constraints.citation_missing: 25 §8: 'Missing, stale, unverifiable, or contradictory evidence is a release failure.'
x-blueprint-constraints.citation_documentation: 25 §1: 'The only valid runtime release status is the status supported by signed evidence under 11_EXECUTION_GATES.md.' 11: 'This gate is not satisfied by documentation alone.'
